verses.original: וַתֵּצֵ֤א דִינָה֙ בַּת־ לֵאָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֖ה לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב לִרְא֖וֹת בִּבְנ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·ṣê ḏî·nāh baṯ- lê·’āh ’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏāh lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lir·’ō·wṯ biḇ·nō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now Dinah the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob went out to visit the daughters of the land
verses.literalPt: E SAIU Diná, filha de Lia, que esta dera a Jacó, para ver as filhas da terra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨רְא אֹתָ֜הּ שְׁכֶ֧ם בֶּן־ חֲמ֛וֹר הַֽחִוִּ֖י נְשִׂ֣יא הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֹתָ֛הּ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אֹתָ֖הּ וַיְעַנֶּֽהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ō·ṯāh šə·ḵem ben- ḥă·mō·wr ha·ḥiw·wî nə·śî hā·’ā·reṣ way·yiq·qaḥ ’ō·ṯāh way·yiš·kaḇ ’ō·ṯāh way·‘an·ne·hā
verses.literal: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite the prince of the region saw her he took her and lay with her by force
verses.literalPt: E Siquém, filho de Hamor, heveu, príncipe daquela terra, viu-a, e tomou-a, e deitou-se com ela, e humilhou-a.

verses.original: וַתִּדְבַּ֣ק נַפְשׁ֔וֹ בְּדִינָ֖ה בַּֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיֶּֽאֱהַב֙ אֶת־ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר עַל־ לֵ֥ב הַֽנַּעֲרָֽ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḏ·baq nap̄·šōw bə·ḏî·nāh baṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·ye·’ĕ·haḇ ’eṯ- han·na·‘ă·rā way·ḏab·bêr ‘al- lêḇ han·na·‘ă·rā
verses.literal: And his soul was drawn to Dinah the daughter of Jacob He loved the young girl and spoke to her tenderly . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E apegou-se a sua alma com Diná, filha de Jacó, e amou a moça e falou afetuosamente à moça.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁכֶ֔ם אֶל־ חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר קַֽח־ לִ֛י אֶת־ הַיַּלְדָּ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·ḵem ’el- ḥă·mō·wr ’ā·ḇîw lê·mōr qaḥ- lî ’eṯ- hay·yal·dāh haz·zōṯ lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: So Shechem . . . told his father . . . Hamor Get me this girl as a wife
verses.literalPt: Falou também Siquém a Hamor, seu pai, dizendo: Toma-me esta moça por mulher.

verses.original: וְיַעֲקֹ֣ב שָׁמַ֗ע כִּ֤י טִמֵּא֙ אֶת־ דִּינָ֣ה בִתּ֔וֹ וּבָנָ֛יו הָי֥וּ אֶת־ מִקְנֵ֖הוּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְהֶחֱרִ֥שׁ יַעֲקֹ֖ב עַד־ בֹּאָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ šā·ma‘ kî ṭim·mê ’eṯ- dî·nāh ḇit·tōw ū·ḇā·nāw hā·yū ’eṯ- miq·nê·hū baś·śā·ḏeh wə·he·ḥĕ·riš ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘aḏ- bō·’ām
verses.literal: Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled his daughter Dinah but since his sons were with his livestock in the field he remained silent about it until they returned
verses.literalPt: Quando Jacó ouviu que Diná, sua filha, fora violada, estavam os seus filhos no campo com o gado; e calou-se Jacó até que viessem.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֛א חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי־ שְׁכֶ֖ם אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְדַבֵּ֖ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ḥă·mō·wr ’ă·ḇî- šə·ḵem ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Shechem’s . . . father Hamor came to speak with Jacob
verses.literalPt: E saiu Hamor, pai de Siquém, a Jacó, para falar com ele.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֨י יַעֲקֹ֜ב בָּ֤אוּ מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶה֙ כְּשָׁמְעָ֔ם וַיִּֽתְעַצְּבוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיִּ֥חַר לָהֶ֖ם מְאֹ֑ד כִּֽי־ נְבָלָ֞ה עָשָׂ֣ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־ בַּֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְכֵ֖ן לֹ֥א יֵעָשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ya·‘ă·qōḇ bā·’ū min- haś·śā·ḏeh kə·šā·mə·‘ām way·yiṯ·‘aṣ·ṣə·ḇū hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yi·ḥar lā·hem mə·’ōḏ kî- nə·ḇā·lāh ‘ā·śāh ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl liš·kaḇ ’eṯ- baṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ḵên lō yê·‘ā·śeh
verses.literal: When Jacob’s sons heard what had happened they returned from the field They were filled with grief . . . and fury because Shechem had committed an outrage in Israel by lying with Jacob’s daughter a thing that should not be done
verses.literalPt: E vieram os filhos de Jacó do campo, ouvindo isso, e entristeceram-se os homens, e iraram-se muito, porquanto Siquém cometera uma insensatez em Israel, deitando-se com a filha de Jacó; o que não se devia fazer assim.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר חֲמ֖וֹר אִתָּ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנִ֗י חָֽשְׁקָ֤ה נַפְשׁוֹ֙ בְּבִתְּכֶ֔ם תְּנ֨וּ נָ֥א אֹתָ֛הּ ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ḥă·mō·wr ’it·tām lê·mōr šə·ḵem bə·nî ḥā·šə·qāh nap̄·šōw bə·ḇit·tə·ḵem tə·nū nā ’ō·ṯāh lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: But Hamor said to them . . . My son Shechem longs for . . . your daughter Please give her to him as his wife
verses.literalPt: Então falou Hamor com eles, dizendo: A alma de Siquém, meu filho, está enamorada da vossa filha; dai-lha, peço-vos, por mulher;

verses.original: וְהִֽתְחַתְּנ֖וּ אֹתָ֑נוּ בְּנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ תִּתְּנוּ־ לָ֔נוּ וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ תִּקְח֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·ḥat·tə·nū ’ō·ṯā·nū bə·nō·ṯê·ḵem tit·tə·nū- lā·nū wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯê·nū tiq·ḥū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Intermarry with us . . . give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves
verses.literalPt: E aparentai-vos conosco, dai-nos as vossas filhas, e tomai as nossas filhas para vós;

verses.original: וְאִתָּ֖נוּ תֵּשֵׁ֑בוּ וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם שְׁבוּ֙ וּסְחָר֔וּהָ וְהֵֽאָחֲז֖וּ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’it·tā·nū tê·šê·ḇū wə·hā·’ā·reṣ tih·yeh lip̄·nê·ḵem šə·ḇū ū·sə·ḥā·rū·hā wə·hê·’ā·ḥă·zū bāh
verses.literal: You may settle among us and the land will be open to you Live here move about freely and acquire your own property
verses.literalPt: E habitareis conosco; e a terra estará diante de vós; habitai e negociai nela, e tomai possessão nela.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁכֶם֙ אֶל־ אָבִ֣יה וְאֶל־ אַחֶ֔יהָ אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֛וּ אֵלַ֖י אֶתֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·ḵem ’el- ʾå̄·ḇīh wə·’el- ’a·ḥe·hā ’em·ṣā- ḥên bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem wa·’ă·šer tō·mə·rū ’ê·lay ’et·tên
verses.literal: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father . . . and brothers Grant me this favor . . . . . . and I will give you whatever you ask . . .
verses.literalPt: E disse Siquém ao pai dela, e aos irmãos dela: Ache eu graça em vossos olhos, e darei o que me disserdes;

verses.original: הַרְבּ֨וּ עָלַ֤י מְאֹד֙ מֹ֣הַר וּמַתָּ֔ן וְאֶ֨תְּנָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑י וּתְנוּ־ לִ֥י אֶת־ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: har·bū ‘ā·lay mə·’ōḏ mō·har ū·mat·tān wə·’et·tə·nāh ka·’ă·šer tō·mə·rū ’ê·lāy ū·ṯə·nū- lî ’eṯ- han·na·‘ă·rā lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: Demand a high . . . dowry and an expensive gift and I will give you whatever you ask . . . Only give me the girl as my wife
verses.literalPt: Aumentai muito sobre mim o dote e a dádiva e darei o que me disserdes; dai-me somente a moça por mulher.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת־ שְׁכֶ֨ם וְאֶת־ חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֛יו בְּמִרְמָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֑רוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר טִמֵּ֔א אֵ֖ת דִּינָ֥ה אֲחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·nū ḇə·nê- ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- šə·ḵem wə·’eṯ- ḥă·mō·wr ’ā·ḇîw bə·mir·māh way·ḏab·bê·rū ’ă·šer ṭim·mê ’êṯ dî·nāh ’ă·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: But because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah Jacob’s sons answered him and his father Hamor deceitfully . . .
verses.literalPt: Então responderam os filhos de Jacó a Siquém e a Hamor, seu pai, enganosamente, e falaram, porquanto havia violado a Diná, sua irmã.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לֹ֤א נוּכַל֙ לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה לָתֵת֙ אֶת־ אֲחֹתֵ֔נוּ לְאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֣וֹ עָרְלָ֑ה כִּֽי־ חֶרְפָּ֥ה הִ֖וא לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ă·lê·hem lō nū·ḵal la·‘ă·śō·wṯ had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh lā·ṯêṯ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·ṯê·nū lə·’îš ’ă·šer- lōw ‘ā·rə·lāh kî- ḥer·pāh hî lā·nū
verses.literal: We cannot . . . do such a thing they said To give our sister . . . to an uncircumcised man . . . would be a disgrace . . . to us
verses.literalPt: E disseram-lhe: Não podemos fazer isso, dar a nossa irmã a um homem não circuncidado; porque isso seria uma vergonha para nós;

verses.original: אַךְ־ בְּזֹ֖את נֵא֣וֹת לָכֶ֑ם אִ֚ם תִּהְי֣וּ כָמֹ֔נוּ לְהִמֹּ֥ל לָכֶ֖ם כָּל־ זָכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- bə·zōṯ nê·’ō·wṯ lā·ḵem ’im tih·yū ḵā·mō·nū lə·him·mōl lā·ḵem kāl- zā·ḵār
verses.literal: We will consent to this on one . . . condition that you become circumcised like us every one of your males
verses.literalPt: Nisso, porém, consentiremos a vós: se fordes como nós; que se circuncide todo o homem entre vós;

verses.original: וְנָתַ֤נּוּ אֶת־ בְּנֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נִֽקַּֽח־ לָ֑נוּ וְיָשַׁ֣בְנוּ אִתְּכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֖ינוּ לְעַ֥ם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan·nū ’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯê·nū lā·ḵem wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯê·ḵem niq·qaḥ- lā·nū wə·yā·šaḇ·nū ’it·tə·ḵem wə·hā·yî·nū lə·‘am ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves We will dwell among you and become one people
verses.literalPt: Então dar-vos-emos as nossas filhas, e tomaremos nós as vossas filhas, e habitaremos convosco, e seremos um povo;

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֧א תִשְׁמְע֛וּ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ לְהִמּ֑וֹל וְלָקַ֥חְנוּ אֶת־ בִּתֵּ֖נוּ וְהָלָֽכְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯiš·mə·‘ū ’ê·lê·nū lə·him·mō·wl wə·lā·qaḥ·nū ’eṯ- bit·tê·nū wə·hā·lā·ḵə·nū
verses.literal: But if you will not agree . . . to be circumcised then we will take our sister and go
verses.literalPt: Mas se não nos ouvirdes, e não vos circuncidardes, tomaremos a nossa filha e ir-nos-emos.

verses.original: וַיִּֽיטְב֥וּ דִבְרֵיהֶ֖ם בְּעֵינֵ֣י חֲמ֑וֹר וּבְעֵינֵ֖י שְׁכֶ֥ם בֶּן־ חֲמֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·ṭə·ḇū ḏiḇ·rê·hem bə·‘ê·nê ḥă·mō·wr ū·ḇə·‘ê·nê šə·ḵem ben- ḥă·mō·wr
verses.literal: Their offer . . . seemed good to Hamor . . . and his son Shechem
verses.literalPt: E suas palavras foram boas aos olhos de Hamor, e aos olhos de Siquém, filho de Hamor.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ אֵחַ֤ר הַנַּ֙עַר֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַדָּבָ֔ר כִּ֥י חָפֵ֖ץ בְּבַֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְה֣וּא נִכְבָּ֔ד מִכֹּ֖ל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’ê·ḥar han·na·‘ar la·‘ă·śō·wṯ had·dā·ḇār kî ḥā·p̄êṣ bə·ḇaṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·hū niḵ·bāḏ mik·kōl bêṯ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: The young man who was the most respected of all his father’s household did not hesitate to fulfill this request because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter
verses.literalPt: E não tardou o jovem em fazer isto; porque a filha de Jacó lhe contentava; e ele era o mais honrado de toda a casa de seu pai.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א חֲמ֛וֹר וּשְׁכֶ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ אֶל־ שַׁ֣עַר עִירָ֑ם וַֽיְדַבְּר֛וּ אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י עִירָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ḥă·mō·wr ū·šə·ḵem bə·nōw ’el- ša·‘ar ‘î·rām way·ḏab·bə·rū ’el- ’an·šê ‘î·rām lê·mōr
verses.literal: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city and addressed . . . the men of their city . . .
verses.literalPt: Veio, pois, Hamor e Siquém, seu filho, à porta da sua cidade, e falaram aos homens da sua cidade, dizendo:

verses.original: הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה שְֽׁלֵמִ֧ים הֵ֣ם אִתָּ֗נוּ וְיֵשְׁב֤וּ בָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וְיִסְחֲר֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ וְהָאָ֛רֶץ הִנֵּ֥ה רַֽחֲבַת־ יָדַ֖יִם לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם אֶת־ בְּנֹתָם֙ נִקַּֽח־ לָ֣נוּ לְנָשִׁ֔ים וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ נִתֵּ֥ן לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh šə·lê·mîm hêm ’it·tā·nū wə·yê·šə·ḇū ḇā·’ā·reṣ wə·yis·ḥă·rū ’ō·ṯāh wə·hā·’ā·reṣ hin·nêh ra·ḥă·ḇaṯ- yā·ḏa·yim lip̄·nê·hem ’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯām niq·qaḥ- lā·nū lə·nā·šîm wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯê·nū nit·tên lā·hem
verses.literal: These men are at peace . . . with us Let them live and trade in our land indeed it is large . . . enough for them Let us take . . . their daughters in marriage and give our daughters to them
verses.literalPt: Estes homens são pacíficos conosco; portanto habitarão nesta terra, e negociarão nela; eis que a terra é larga de espaço para eles; tomaremos nós as suas filhas por mulheres, e lhes daremos as nossas filhas.

verses.original: אַךְ־ בְּ֠זֹאת יֵאֹ֨תוּ לָ֤נוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אִתָּ֔נוּ לִהְי֖וֹת לְעַ֣ם אֶחָ֑ד בְּהִמּ֥וֹל לָ֙נוּ֙ כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר הֵ֥ם נִמֹּלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- bə·zōṯ yê·’ō·ṯū lā·nū hā·’ă·nā·šîm lā·še·ḇeṯ ’it·tā·nū lih·yō·wṯ lə·‘am ’e·ḥāḏ bə·him·mō·wl lā·nū kāl- zā·ḵār ka·’ă·šer hêm nim·mō·lîm
verses.literal: But only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us and be one people if all our men are circumcised as they are . . .
verses.literalPt: Nisto, porém, consentirão aqueles homens, em habitar conosco, para que sejamos um povo, se todo o homem entre nós se circuncidar, como eles são circuncidados.

verses.original: מִקְנֵהֶ֤ם וְקִנְיָנָם֙ וְכָל־ בְּהֶמְתָּ֔ם הֲל֥וֹא לָ֖נוּ הֵ֑ם אַ֚ךְ נֵא֣וֹתָה לָהֶ֔ם וְיֵשְׁב֖וּ אִתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: miq·nê·hem wə·qin·yā·nām wə·ḵāl bə·hem·tām hă·lō·w lā·nū hêm ’aḵ nê·’ō·w·ṯāh lā·hem wə·yê·šə·ḇū ’it·tā·nū
verses.literal: Will not their livestock their possessions and all their animals become ours Only let us consent to them and they will dwell among us
verses.literalPt: E seu gado, as suas possessões, e todos os seus animais não serão nossos? Consintamos somente com eles e habitarão conosco.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֤וּ אֶל־ חֲמוֹר֙ וְאֶל־ שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ כָּל־ יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֣עַר עִיר֑וֹ וַיִּמֹּ֙לוּ֙ כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר כָּל־ יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֥עַר עִירֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū ’el- ḥă·mō·wr wə·’el- šə·ḵem bə·nōw kāl- yō·ṣə·’ê ša·‘ar ‘î·rōw way·yim·mō·lū kāl- zā·ḵār kāl- yō·ṣə·’ê ša·‘ar ‘î·rōw
verses.literal: All the men who went out of the city gate listened to Hamor . . . and his son Shechem and every male . . . of the city was circumcised
verses.literalPt: E deram ouvidos a Hamor e a Siquém, seu filho, todos os que saíam da porta da cidade; e foi circuncidado todo o homem, de todos os que saíam pela porta da sua cidade.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֣ם כֹּֽאֲבִ֗ים וַיִּקְח֣וּ שְׁנֵֽי־ בְנֵי־ יַ֠עֲקֹב שִׁמְע֨וֹן וְלֵוִ֜י אֲחֵ֤י דִינָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ חַרְבּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ עַל־ הָעִ֖יר בֶּ֑טַח וַיַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כָּל־ זָכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî bih·yō·w·ṯām kō·’ă·ḇîm way·yiq·ḥū šə·nê- ḇə·nê- ya·‘ă·qōḇ šim·‘ō·wn wə·lê·wî ’ă·ḥê ḏî·nāh ’îš ḥar·bōw way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘al- hā·‘îr be·ṭaḥ way·ya·har·ḡū kāl- zā·ḵār
verses.literal: Three days later while they were still in pain two of Jacob’s sons Dinah’s . . . brothers Simeon and Levi took their swords went into the unsuspecting city and slaughtered every male
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, ao terceiro dia, quando estavam com a mais violenta dor, os dois filhos de Jacó, Simeão e Levi, irmãos de Diná, tomaram cada um a sua espada, e entraram afoitamente na cidade, e mataram todos os homens.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ חֲמוֹר֙ וְאֶת־ שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ הָרְג֖וּ לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב וַיִּקְח֧וּ אֶת־ דִּינָ֛ה מִבֵּ֥ית שְׁכֶ֖ם וַיֵּצֵֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ḥă·mō·wr wə·’eṯ- šə·ḵem bə·nōw hā·rə·ḡū lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- dî·nāh mib·bêṯ šə·ḵem way·yê·ṣê·’ū
verses.literal: They killed . . . Hamor and his son Shechem with their swords took Dinah out of Shechem’s house and went away
verses.literalPt: Mataram também ao fio da espada a Hamor, e a seu filho Siquém; e tomaram a Diná da casa de Siquém, e saíram.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּ֚אוּ עַל־ הַ֣חֲלָלִ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֖זּוּ הָעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר טִמְּא֖וּ אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ya·‘ă·qōḇ bā·’ū ‘al- ha·ḥă·lā·lîm way·yā·ḇōz·zū hā·‘îr ’ă·šer ṭim·mə·’ū ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Jacob’s other sons came upon the slaughter and looted the city because their sister had been defiled
verses.literalPt: Vieram os filhos de Jacó aos mortos e saquearam a cidade; porquanto violaram a sua irmã.

verses.original: אֶת־ צֹאנָ֥ם וְאֶת־ בְּקָרָ֖ם וְאֶת־ חֲמֹרֵיהֶּ֑ם וְאֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־ בָּעִ֛יר וְאֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה לָקָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ṣō·nām wə·’eṯ- bə·qā·rām wə·’eṯ- ḥă·mō·rē·hɛm wə·’êṯ ’ă·šer- bā·‘îr wə·’eṯ- ’ă·šer baś·śā·ḏeh lā·qā·ḥū
verses.literal: They took their flocks and herds and donkeys and everything else in the city - or in the field
verses.literalPt: As suas ovelhas, e as suas vacas, e os seus jumentos, e o que havia na cidade e no campo, tomaram.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֵילָ֤ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־ נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם שָׁב֖וּ וַיָּבֹ֑זּוּ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥê·lām wə·’eṯ- kāl- ṭap·pām wə·’eṯ- nə·šê·hem šā·ḇū way·yā·ḇōz·zū wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer bab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: They carried off all their possessions and women and children and they plundered everything in their houses
verses.literalPt: E todos os seus bens, e todos os seus meninos, e as suas mulheres, levaram presos, e saquearam tudo o que havia em casa.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶל־ שִׁמְע֣וֹן וְאֶל־ לֵוִי֮ עֲכַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִי֒ לְהַבְאִישֵׁ֙נִי֙ בְּיֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּבַפְּרִזִּ֑י וַאֲנִי֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר וְנֶאֶסְפ֤וּ עָלַי֙ וְהִכּ֔וּנִי וְנִשְׁמַדְתִּ֖י אֲנִ֥י וּבֵיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- šim·‘ō·wn wə·’el- lê·wî ‘ă·ḵar·tem ’ō·ṯî lə·haḇ·’î·šê·nî bə·yō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ bak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ū·ḇap·pə·riz·zî wa·’ă·nî mə·ṯê mis·pār wə·ne·’es·p̄ū ‘ā·lay wə·hik·kū·nî wə·niš·maḏ·tî ’ă·nî ū·ḇê·ṯî
verses.literal: Then Jacob said to Simeon . . . and Levi You have brought trouble upon me by making me a stench to the Canaanites and Perizzites the people of this land We are few in number if they unite against me and attack me I and my household will be destroyed
verses.literalPt: Então disse Jacó a Simeão e a Levi: Tendes-me turbado, fazendo-me cheirar mal entre os moradores desta terra, entre os cananeus e perizeus; tendo eu pouco povo em número, eles ajuntar-se-ão, e serei destruído, eu e minha casa.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֑וּ הַכְזוֹנָ֕ה יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־ אֲחוֹתֵֽנוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū haḵ·zō·w·nāh ya·‘ă·śeh ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: But they replied Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute
verses.literalPt: E eles disseram: Devia ele tratar a nossa irmã como a uma prostituta?
